title: Wringer evidence bundle manifest
description: manifest.json — the index of one `wring verify` run. Written once, at the end of the run. Schema version wringer.evidence.v1; any change to this shape is a spec change and bumps that version.

schema_version.description: Identifies the bundle format a reader is holding.

run_id.description: The run directory's name. Normally YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<4 hex>, but `--output DIR` lets a caller name it anything, so readers must not parse this for a timestamp.

started_at.description: Local time with UTC offset, seconds precision.

root.description: Always "." — the bundle lives inside the repo it describes, so paths stay repo-relative and the bundle stays portable.

head_sha.description: Full 40-character HEAD SHA, or null when git could not be read.

branch.description: Branch name, or null on a detached HEAD or when git could not be read.

dirty.description: Whether the tree had changed or untracked files when the run started.

status.description: passed = every required gate passed. failed = a required gate failed. interrupted = the run stopped before every gate finished.

failed_gate.description: The id of the required gate that failed, or null. Null on an interrupted run too: stopping is not failing.
